meta.title: beamlynx - Visual & Intuitive Database Queries
meta.description: Beamlynx is a visual database client that makes database interactions delightful. Explore and interact with your data using pine-lang, a simple, intuitive query language.
meta.ogDescription: A visual database client that makes database interactions delightful. Explore and interact with your data using pine-lang, a simple, intuitive query language.
meta.twitterDescription: A visual database client that makes database interactions delightful.

hero.description: Write queries in <1>pine-lang</1>, a simple, composable language that converts seamlessly to SQL — while your database's relationships render live as a schematic you can click through.
hero.diagramAriaLabel: Canvas mode diagram of the customers, orders, order_items and products tables joined in sequence, matching the query below

visual.title: Visual
visual.description: See your database's relationships rendered live, as a graph, while you write — no separate ERD tool to keep in sync.

composable.title: Composable
composable.description: <1>pine-lang</1> is a composable domain-specific language that converts straight to SQL. Focus on the shape of the question, not the syntax.

interactive.title: Interactive
interactive.description: Click through tables in a live graph and watch the query build itself — join paths light up as you go.

closing.heading: Point it at a database and start exploring.
